title: Model design for serving
brief: Fit the loss, find the model that minimizes training plus lifetime inference FLOPs, and rank candidate shapes by decode bytes per token.
hints: Compute-optimal N is G (C/6)^a with a = beta/(alpha+beta) and G = (alpha A / (beta B))^(1/(alpha+beta)). D follows from C = 6 N D.
With served tokens the optimum has no closed form. Each N fixes D through the loss target, so search over N alone.
Decode reads every weight once per step, shared by the batch. The KV cache and the recurrent state belong to each sequence.
